question: GQ-007
subject: reading the 220 books I added today, and finding six that are not English
why: I verified structure — headings, retention, duplicates — and never content. An unread book is inventory.
what_the_new_tier_brought: The practice of physick (17th c, 8,867 passages)
The medical and surgical history of the War of the Rebellion

the_finding.method: English-dictionary hit rate per book over 300-char previews
the_finding.separation: every English book above 45%; six books at 18-21%
the_finding.what_they_are: 5 German, 1 Latin — Janus (German medical-history journal), Freind's Historia medicinae
the_finding.root_cause: the want-list filters IA on language:eng and IA's metadata is wrong for these six
the_finding.not_ocr_damage: long-s books score fine — the dictionary still matches most of their words

reported_not_fatal: a German medical-history journal is a legitimate book the SELECTION let in. Whether the Library wants non-English material is not a decision this gate should make.

a_probe_of_mine_that_was_too_small.what: injected a fake German book with 5 passages — not detected
a_probe_of_mine_that_was_too_small.cause: the check requires 200+ words before scoring, deliberately, so short books do not produce noise
a_probe_of_mine_that_was_too_small.lesson: the check was right and my test was undersized — the same mistake as asserting a count instead of deriving it

a_selection_error_i_made_first.what: used rowid desc to find "the newest books" and got London Magazine volumes from the FIRST list
a_selection_error_i_made_first.cause: the migration rewrites rows, so rowid order is not insertion order
a_selection_error_i_made_first.fix: selected by want-list identifier instead — all 119 present
